Class BuildYourOwnTest

java.lang.Object
main.java.BuildYourOwnTest
public class BuildYourOwnTest extends Object
JUnit test class for the BuildYourOwn pizza price() method. Uses Black-Box testing: tests are based on the specification (base price by size + $1.69 per topping, up to 5 toppings).
